pageSubtitle: KPI 9 — Dormant Customer Value. Estimated potential revenue lost from customers who have gone inactive.
m9SectionLabel: M9 · Dormant Customer Value — Estimated Lost Revenue Ranking
m9ChartTitle: Top Dormant Customers — Ranked by Estimated Lost Value
m9ChartSubtitle: Sorted by highest lost value · Estimate = avg revenue over the last 12 months before going dormant × months dormant
m9Formula:
Estimated Lost Value = Avg Monthly Revenue × Months Dormant

Avg Monthly Revenue = total revenue over the 12 calendar months
BEFORE the customer's last transaction, divided by 12
Months Dormant = (reference date − last transaction date) ÷ 30,
rounded, minimum 1 month
m9FormulaNote: Shows the top 20 customers by estimated lost value.
emptyTable: No dormant customers for this scope/period
